name: Musco Sports Lighting, LLC
old_description: Since 2023, Bullitt County Public Schools has standardized the lighting performance across its athletic facilities at North, Central, and East High Schools. They’ve invested in Musco LED systems for football, baseball, softball, and tennis, with tailored solutions for new installations and retrofit applications. Additionally, each football stadium now features color-changing luminaires and Show-Light® entertainment technology.
about:
Musco Sports Lighting, LLC is headquartered in Oskaloosa, Iowa. Founded over half a century ago, the company has grown from its Iowa roots into a global provider of sports and large-area lighting systems.

The company designs and manufactures LED lighting systems for sports venues, transportation infrastructure, entertainment facilities, and videoboard installations. Its proprietary platforms include the Light-Structure System™, 5 Easy Pieces™ packaged solutions, and the Mini-Pitch System™ for community recreation. Musco also provides the Control-Link® remote monitoring service, which offers 24/7 proactive system oversight and remote on/off control. The firm employs more than 2,100 team members worldwide and reports that each Mini-Pitch System™ impacts approximately 10,000 youth.

Musco serves K–12 school districts, universities, municipal parks departments, professional sports clubs, and international governing bodies. Recent projects include lighting upgrades for Blackpool FC’s Bloomfield Road stadium in England, the Gaelic Athletic Association’s Croke Park in Dublin, Chimney Park ball fields in Windsor, Colorado, and the University of Idaho’s multi-use facility. In 2023, Bullitt County Public Schools in Kentucky standardized on Musco LED systems for football, baseball, softball, and tennis across three high schools. The company was also named the Official Sport Presentation and Broadcast Lighting Provider for the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games.

Musco’s founding principle states that the company exists for the benefit of its team, a philosophy it credits for decades-long employee retention. The firm emphasizes responsible lighting that minimizes spill light and glare, protects the night sky, and reduces energy consumption. It also assists customers with project planning, funding identification, financing options, and long-term warranty support.
